judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger mandate, successfully claimed both the refund and compensation, and correctly rejected the travel voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling British Airways. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to British Airways, my name is Sophie. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Sophie, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Emily Clarke, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Whiskey Nine Romeo Delta Three Lima, flight BA1446.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Emily. I can see your booking reference W9RD3L for flight BA1446. I understand you're calling about the cancellation. Could you confirm if you're seeking a refund under UK261 for a cancellation with less than 14 days' notice?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. The flight was cancelled with only 48 hours' notice, and the reason given was crew availability. I'm seeking a full refund of 164 pounds under UK261 Article 5(1)(a) and Article 8, plus the cancellation compensation of 220 pounds owed for a flight of this distance under Article 5(1)(c) and Article 7.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm afraid a travel voucher won't work for the passenger. She's entitled to a full cash refund of 164 pounds to her original payment method, plus the 220 pounds compensation under UK261. Could you please process that instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, Emily. I'll process a full refund of 164 pounds to your original payment method, plus the 220 pounds compensation as requested. Your reference number is 3 V 8 3 5 N.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Sophie. Just to confirm, the reference number is Three Victor Eight Three Five November. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do on her end?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: You're welcome, and the reference number is correctly noted as 3 V 8 3 5 N. No further action is required from you, Emily. Safe travels!
